items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-review-quasi-coherent at source lines 1519-1546, a seven-part statement: the presheaf F^a(Y) = Gamma(Y, f^*F) satisfies the fpqc (hence fppf and etale) sheaf condition; F^a = pi_X^*F on the big etale site and F^a = a_X^*F on the big fppf site; F -> F^a is an equivalence between quasi-coherent O_X-modules and quasi-coherent modules on the big etale (resp. fppf) site; and the identities epsilon_{X,*}a_X^*F = pi_X^*F, a_{X,*}a_X^*F = F and the vanishing of both higher direct images. The author's proof at source lines 1548-1596 proves part (1) by fppc descent of quasi-coherent modules: turning compatible sections into compatible maps O_U -> g^*F and descending them (a cross-chapter proposition declared as a pointer); then reduces parts (2)-(7) to the case of a scheme by choosing an etale covering by schemes, observing that the covering is a covering of the final object in each of the three sites so that sheaves are descent data (a cross-chapter glueing lemma), noting that each of the seven properties is local, and finishing with the equivalences of ringed topoi for a scheme (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies, retained as context) and the scheme case (a cross-chapter pointer), using that being quasi-coherent is intrinsic (another pointer). The author closes with the remark 'Some minor details omitted.'; that remark is reproduced verbatim and the card adds nothing in its place.
